messages:
rachel_cs: Quick ask 1: were scheduling a hands-on enablement clinic tomorrow morning. Several renewal-risk customers (Greenline, AsterMed) requested migration + SLA tuning. Can we reframe office hours into a compact Clinic: Migration + SLA Tuning? Need engineer lead + triage owner.
devin_eng: I can lead the engineering portion for 20m. I'll cover KV cache behavior, batching knobs, and basic perf tripping points. Will need a short checklist and one reproducible sample.
emma_ops: I'll update the invite and attach the checklist. Do we want to make it invite-only for renewal contacts? Could do a prioritized attendee list and an open follow-up drop-in.
rachel_cs: Yes prioritized invite list please. Also request a 15m dedicated follow-up block for renewal owners to map action items.
leo_sales: Greenline asked for a migration runbook walk-through and a timeline estimate. If we can demo a migration path, that'll help the deal. Add them to the priority list.
jamal_support: I'll run live notes and record action items into the customer tracker. Also can paste the shared triage doc in the invite comments.
devin_eng: For demo we should check non-prod API keys exist. Emma, can you include a pre-session intake asking: (1) have non-prod creds, (2) current model variant, (3) peak QPS? That will help scope the tune.
emma_ops: Yup I'll add intake form: https://forms.gle/enablement-clinic-2026. I'll also attach pre-read: https://docs.redwood.com/guides/migration-checklist.
cs-bot: :bell: Office hours updated Zoom 555-0199. Room reserved 09:4010:30 PT. Calendar invite sent.
rachel_cs: Proposed compact agenda:
```
Agenda:
- 09:45 intro & goals (5m)
- 09:50 migration runbook walkthrough (10m) Rachel/devin
- 10:00 engineering clinic: KV caching + batching (20m) Devin
- 10:20 focused Q&A + account triage (20m)
```
Were keeping the core session 45m to respect customer time, then 15m private triage.
leo_sales: Can we add a quick poll in the invite for a 1:1 follow-up (yes/no)? Helps route renewal owners.
devin_eng: Slide deck 2-3 slides incoming from me by EOD. Will also share a tiny repro script:```bash
# run tiny perf repro
python repro.py --tokens 512 --batch 4
```
jamal_support: I'll post the triage doc link here once Emma updates the invite. Volunteers to own follow-ups? Rachel, can you take AsterMed? I can take Greenline.
rachel_cs: I can own AsterMed follow-ups. Thanks Jamal.
emma_ops: Invite updated, pre-read attached, intake form added, and poll created. Attendee list prioritized and pinned in the channel.
rachel_cs: Final checks: please confirm slides, repro snippet, and demo creds by 5pm. If anyone can't make the slot, flag now so we can swap presenters.
devin_eng: Confirmed. I'll ping when slides + repro are uploaded.
leo_sales: I'll ensure Greenline's renewal owner gets the invite and completes the intake.
cs-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder set for 30m before. Recording enabled.
rachel_cs: Great team thanks. After session we'll send a 3-question feedback form (clarity, helpfulness, next asks) to attendees. Drop any blockers here.
